name: Tanque Default — Cañón
generation_strategy: NO se genera individualmente. Se extrae del panel derecho de tank-default-group.png (1536×1024). Ver tank-default-body.json para el prompt combinado.

frames.role: Cañón del tanque default — gira independiente del cuerpo
frames.prompt: A cartoon tank cannon sprite viewed strictly from directly above at exactly 90 degrees (pure bird's eye / zenith view). The camera looks STRAIGHT DOWN — you see only the TOP-DOWN cross-section of the cannon barrel. The barrel appears as a NARROW ELONGATED RECTANGLE (or slightly oval tube shape seen from above) pointing straight UP toward 12 o'clock. The base (bottom of the image) is a slightly wider rounded rectangle — the turret mounting ring seen from above. The barrel narrows slightly toward the tip (top of image). Dark gray (#555566) color. Simple 2-tone cel shading on the top surface: a thin light gray highlight stripe along one side of the barrel, dark gray shadow along the other — both running lengthwise on the flat top face. Bold black outline 4px. The pivot/rotation point is at the base (bottom-center). Isolated on transparent background, centered vertically. This is NOT a side view of a cannon — it is the OVERHEAD TOP-DOWN VIEW of a barrel pointing away from you (the tip is at the top, the base is at the bottom). Cel-shaded cartoon style, chunky proportions, clean and readable. NO tank body, NOT realistic, NOT pixel art, NO text, NO watermark.
frames.negative_prompt: realistic, pixel art, full tank body, military realism, thin barrel, background scenery, text, watermark, side view, isometric, 3/4 view, angled perspective, cylindrical side view, barrel in profile

phaser_config.notes: origin.y = 0.75 para que el pivote esté en la base del cañón. El cañón apunta hacia arriba en la imagen (eje -Y de Phaser = 0 grados). Hijo del sprite del cuerpo, posicionado en su centro.
